content.description: Electrical wiring diagram showing diagnosis circuit connections between battery, fuses, No. 1 Main Relay, Check Engine Warning Light, Check Connector, and ECU. Shows various terminals including BAT, +B, M-REL, W, IG S/W, T, E1, and ground connections.
Diagnostic flowchart with two main sections (1 and 2) for troubleshooting the CHECK ENG. warning light system

steps.question: Does CHECK ENG. warning light come on when ignition switch is at ON?
Does CHECK ENG. light come on when ECU terminal W is grounded to the body?
steps.yes_path: Check wiring between ECU terminal E1 and body ground → OK → Try another ECU

steps.question: Check bulb, fuse and wiring between ECU and ignition switch.
Does CHECK ENG. warning light go OFF when engine is started?
Check wiring between ECU and CHECK ENG. warning light.
Is there diagnosis code output when service connector is short circuited?
Does CHECK ENG. warning light go out after repair according to malfunction code?
steps.yes_path: System OK → Cancel out Diagnostic code
